page.overview:
Who is Ragnir?

Ragnir was an Edain man of the House of Hador.

Ragnir was a blind servant in the household of Húrin and Morwen at the time following the Nírnaeth Arnoediad. As Morwen was about to arrange for her son Túrin to go to Doriath, he was worried that Morwen would be left with only Ragnir, Sador, and a few old women to tend the house.
